moods.name: Chill
moods.description: Easygoing music for slowing down and settling into the moment. Nothing demanding, nothing to escape from.

moods.name: Vibes
moods.descriptor: Laid-back grooves, mellow rhythms, effortless flow.
moods.blurb: For settling into a good groove.
moods.description: Warm basslines, relaxed rhythms, and easygoing energy. Music for when you want to move, but slowly.

moods.name: Hazy
moods.blurb: For getting lost in the sound.
moods.description: Pulls you out of your surroundings. Floating melodies, washed-out textures, and atmospheres that feel removed from reality.

moods.name: Tender
moods.description: Warmth, care, and emotional openness. Love in its quieter, more vulnerable forms.

moods.name: Sensual
moods.description: Seductive grooves, physical intimacy, and slow-building tension. Felt as much as heard.

moods.name: Euphoric
moods.blurb: For feeling on top of the world.
moods.description: A sense of possibility, excitement, or emotional release. From quiet optimism to overwhelming joy.

moods.name: Electric
moods.blurb: For when you need to move.
moods.description: Driven by rhythm and physical energy. The kind that makes staying still difficult.

_about: Listen mood words (PROJECT-SPEC.md §7), edited in the CMS under Listen Moods. The page matches each entry to content/listen/moods.json by id.

Only descriptor, blurb, description, and picks are read from here. Names, colors, art, live flags, playlist URLs, and order all come from moods.json; name is here only so the CMS can list each mood by name.
UNDECIDED or blank = the page shows nothing for that field rather than inventing copy.
Kept separate from moods.json because Decap CMS rewrites objects with more than eight keys in a scrambled key order. Keep each entry to these six keys.
